checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: Compare FK of decoded IK joints with the demonstrated commanded TCP target in metres/radians and compare the unmodified gripper scalar. Rotation 6D is deterministically projected to SO(3); unconverged IK is returned with diagnostics rather than replaced.

contract.cut_relation: Uses every assigned action in [900,1330) for all 12 trajectories. The full [900,1160) action-supervised overlap with place_block_in_drawer is preserved; only Cartesian representation and causal coordinates are changed.
contract.output_semantics: Each slot is [target-frame xyz metres, target-frame relative rotation 6D, native gripper scalar]. The frame is target_pose from that slot's action observation for labels and from the freshly measured current observation for decoding. The 6D pair is projected by Gram-Schmidt to SO(3), composed with target_pose to a world TCP target, and passed to panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured joints. Gripper >=0 opens and <0 closes. Slots represent t-1 through t+14; execution uses slots 1 through 8.
contract.parameter_semantics: No high-level arguments. target_pose is the observed moving drawer-attached frame in world metres with a wxyz quaternion. The executor supplies two causal observations and a fresh observation for each decoded slot.
